content: CDD Topology support The elements UserDefinedClus- ter , UserDefinedPhysicalChannel , UserDefinedCommunicationConnec- tor and UserDefinedCommunicationController can be used to describe al- ternative communication technologies (e.g. I2C, USB, serial line) that are integrated in AUTOSAR as Complex Drivers.
